verdict.rationale: Teams' Graph docs mention export APIs and note that user-deleted messages remain recoverable for 21 days, showing some retention/deletion behavior exists, but there is no evidence of AI-native controls (e.g., agent-specific data retention settings, deletion APIs for AI interactions, or admin policies tailored to AI usage). Missing for 10: explicit AI/agent data retention controls, user-facing deletion tools, and documentation on how AI interaction data (e.g., Copilot logs) is retained or purged.
